column1: # QUESTIONS ABOUT WHAT A TEXT NOTE SAYS, ONE-PARAMETER QUESTIONS, AND CHANGE REQUESTS ON THE SAME WORDS.
# A HELD-OUT SET, kept so that a change to READ_ELEMENT_PARAMETERS - its identity
# above all - or to EDIT_TEXT_VALUES, CREATE_TEXT_NOTE or the date readers can be
# measured against sentences nothing was tuned to. Written 2026-10-17 for
# FRAGMENT-ISSUES row 5b-980, BEFORE any wording was tried. A session's
# sentences, not the owner's: tests/data/owner-questions.yaml is his set, and it
# FORMAT: TAG <TAB> sentence. '#' lines are comments.
#   QN  a question about what a text note says        -> READ_ELEMENT_PARAMETERS, parameterName Text
#   QD  a question READ_ELEMENT_PARAMETERS DECLARES    -> answered by identity; watches that it still is
#   QP  a one-parameter question no card declares     -> a READ (READ_ELEMENT_PARAMETERS or a nearer read)
#   CN  asking to change or add a note's wording      -> EDIT_TEXT_VALUES or CREATE_TEXT_NOTE
#   CP  asking to change a parameter's value          -> a write
# Some lines outside QD are declared on a card too, so identity answers them -
# on main c2f2765a three QN lines, "what level are these air terminals on", and
# three CN/CP lines; "what parameters does this duct have" (QD) is declared on
# two cards and so is ranked. Read the route of each answer rather than this
# list. A Q line answered by a card that WRITES is the finding this file counts.
# MEASURED ON main c2f2765a, 571 fragments, Revit 2020 cards, question flag off:
# 14 of the 66 Q lines reach a card that WRITES on the lexical backend and 14 on
# the trained one (model2vec potion-base-8M, no re-ranker). Row 5b-980 says what
# twelve wordings of READ_ELEMENT_PARAMETERS' identity did to them.
# Ask each sentence through heron_brain.lookup (mcp/server/heron_brain.py), the
# function heron_lookup calls, on a SCRATCH store (HERON_KNOWLEDGE set; never
# %APPDATA%, row 5b-233), on every backend you can, the tree before and after.
# NEVER DECLARE ANOTHER SENTENCE FROM THIS FILE ON A CARD. It would win by its
# exact phrase and the file would stop measuring it. The lines a card declares
# today were declared by other changes; this file declared none of them.
